tools.name: search
tools.description: Search published Finposter articles, banks, MFOs and financial products.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Finposter brand, contact, social and legal information.

tools.name: get_home
tools.description: Public homepage overview with featured offers, latest news and rates.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List financial product categories and available offer counts.

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: Category description, supported filters, partners and FAQ. Use slugs returned by list_categories.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List published financial offers by category. Discover category slugs and filters with list_categories and get_category. Promotional rates are not necessarily total credit costs.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full published product terms, provider, related offers and reviews. Use type and slug returned by list_products.

tools.name: list_partners
tools.description: Find banks and microfinance organizations by name or type.

tools.name: get_partner
tools.description: Bank or MFO profile, products, branches and published reviews.

tools.name: get_bank_rating
tools.description: Finposter bank rating and rating tabs; reflects the site methodology.

tools.name: list_news_categories
tools.description: Published news categories.

tools.name: list_guide_categories
tools.description: Financial guide categories.

tools.name: list_news
tools.description: Search or browse published financial news, newest first.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Search or browse published financial education articles.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read a published news or guide article, structured body, sources and related articles.

tools.name: get_exchange_rates
tools.description: Cached NBU exchange rates in UAH per currency unit. Check fetched_at before describing rates as current.

tools.name: list_exchangers
tools.description: Public exchange offers by currency and city, ranked by buy/sell rate. Quotes can change; this does not execute an exchange.

tools.name: list_crypto
tools.description: Cached cryptocurrency prices with source timestamp; no trading execution.

tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: Available financial calculators and example purposes.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: Published answers to common financial questions, optionally by category.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Cities supported by Finposter.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: Published customer reviews, optionally for a bank or product.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read public about, contacts or legal pages.

tools.name: calculate_loan
tools.description: Estimate annuity or differential loan repayments, interest, supplied fees and optional monthly schedule.

tools.name: calculate_deposit
tools.description: Estimate deposit interest with optional monthly capitalization. tax_pct must be explicitly supplied; use 0 for a pre-tax estimate.

tools.name: calculate_microloan
tools.description: Estimate simple daily-interest microloan cost with an explicit term, daily rate and fee.

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Convert between currencies using cached NBU reference rates, including UAH. Reports the source timestamp.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Retrieve 2–5 published offers side by side. Compare full terms, fees and eligibility; this does not make a personalized recommendation.

tools.name: get_data_status
tools.description: Public snapshot freshness, dataset verification dates and available counts. Stale data must not be described as current.

tools.name: list_verified_offers
tools.description: Browse source-attributed offer datasets used by website calculators. Verified means checked on checked_at, not guaranteed current. IDs differ from catalog product IDs.

tools.name: get_verified_offer
tools.description: Read complete terms, rate rows, sources and verification date of a calculator offer.

tools.name: compare_deposit_offers
tools.description: Calculate deposit offers for the same amount, term, currency and explicit tax. Returns ranked net income and exclusion reasons.

tools.name: compare_credit_offers
tools.description: Calculate bank loans for the same cash amount and term, with dated rate rows, fees, APR estimates and reasons for exclusion.

tools.name: compare_mortgage_offers
tools.description: Compare dated mortgage offers with down payment, property type, fees and insurance. User-supplied category is not an eligibility determination. Missing floating indexes exclude a quote.

tools.name: calculate_calendar_loan
tools.description: Calendar loan calculation using the website mortgage engine: dated payments, commissions, day-count conventions and optional early repayments.

tools.name: calculate_mortgage
tools.description: Calculate a mortgage scenario by property price and down payment, calendar dates, fees and early repayments.

tools.name: simulate_early_repayment
tools.description: Compare the same loan with and without explicit early repayments. Reports both totals and savings; no bank action is taken.

tools.name: calculate_calendar_deposit
tools.description: Calendar deposit calculation, explicit tax fractions, day-count, payout frequency, monthly top-ups and capitalization.

tools.name: calculate_compound_interest
tools.description: Compound-interest savings with regular and one-time contributions, explicit tax, calendar dates and capitalization. No investment performance promise.

tools.name: search_glossary
tools.description: Find published financial terms with Ukrainian or Russian display text.

tools.name: get_glossary_term
tools.description: Full published definition, examples and related term identifiers.

tools.name: list_experts
tools.description: Published expert profiles. Does not expose private account details.

tools.name: list_expert_opinions
tools.description: Published expert opinions, optionally by author ID.

tools.name: get_expert_opinion
tools.description: Read a published expert opinion and author attribution.

tools.name: list_bank_exchange_rates
tools.description: Bank cash or card exchange rates with source timestamps. Quotes older than 36 hours are excluded; no exchange is executed.

tools.name: get_bank_rate_history
tools.description: Daily recorded bank rate history for a date range. Missing days remain missing.

tools.name: get_market_statistics
tools.description: Finposter catalog statistics by month, with sample count. Metrics are parsed from catalog descriptions, not a census of the Ukrainian market.

tools.name: search_bank_branches
tools.description: Public branch directory filtered by bank slug and/or city ID. No geolocation permission or private data.

tools.name: list_forum_categories
tools.description: Active public forum categories.

tools.name: search_forum_topics
tools.description: Search published forum topics; user content is unverified opinion. No account IDs, IPs, reports or private attachments.

tools.name: get_forum_topic
tools.description: Read one published forum topic and a paginated set of published replies. Does not include private attachments or account data.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
